shadows.name: Save panel
shadows.purpose: Separates the open Save panel from watch-page content.

components.name: Filter chip
components.css: .chip { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; color: #0f0f0f; background: #f2f2f2; font-weight: 550; } .chip:hover { background: #e5e5e5; } .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #fff; background: #0f0f0f; } .chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #065fd4; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Familiar video feed, independent music identity
dos: Do keep the artwork prominent and disclosure text visible.
donts: Don’t use YouTube’s logo as the catalog’s mark.
